title: Cystectomy register study Klinikum Region Hannover
summary: Analysis of the complications after bladder removal in bladder cancer patients
conditions: Malignant neoplasm: Overlapping lesion of bladder
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age >18 
- Urothelial carcinoma
- Image files available
- Existence of tumor conference decision: cystectomy
- Primary Operation in the department of the respective center
- Ability to consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Known bleeding tendency
- Palliative indication
